name: lecture1_end
note: Lecture mode EXIT, 8 frames @10FPS with holds (20 ticks = 2.0s). She lowers the pointer, tucks it away behind her back, bows politely and straightens back up while the blackboard floats up, shrinks, fades and sparkles away. She slides back to the centre so the last frame matches idle. Frames 2 and 6 are file copies of note1_loop_16 (hands behind back), frame 5 is a copy of frame 3, frame 7 is a copy of note1_loop_00 (the idle base). GENERATOR: flux2-klein-4b on the LAN imagegen server (not gen_frames.py) - see the 'klein' key and prompts/animation_prompts.md for the per-frame recipe. PROP: the blackboard is NOT generated per frame. It is one sprite (sprites/props/blackboard.png) composited behind the character by tools/compose_prop.py using the 'compose' key, because a detached prop is erased by the matte cleanup in slice_and_key.py and would wobble if it were regenerated every frame. The character's move to the right is done there too (compose.frames[].shift), so every generated frame is drawn centred as usual. Keyed with: slice_and_key.py --no-align --no-scale-norm --match sprites/idle1_loop/idle1_loop_00.png into sprites/<name>_char/, then compose_prop.py writes sprites/<name>/.

modes.pose: references = [design ref, anchor frame with a DIFFERENT arm layout]. 'reuse its character, outfit and prop design, but her arms are in a completely NEW position'. The same anchor and seed keep the body, so changing a few words of the pose text gives a controlled variation.
modes.face: references = [design ref, frame N], same seed as N. 'keep the body EXACTLY the same, what CHANGES is her FACE'. The body is copied pixel-stable; only the face changes.
modes.copy: 다른 프레임 파일을 그대로 복사 (생성하지 않음).

frames: Pose: TEACHING key frame, same as lecture1_loop frame 0: pointer tip on the blackboard, eyes to the LEFT. The small lemon-slice hair clip stays on the same side of her bangs as in the reference image, do not mirror the character.

Both eyes look STRAIGHT AT THE VIEWER with a warm satisfied closed-mouth smile. Feet close together. The small lemon-slice hair clip stays on the same side of her bangs as in the reference image, do not mirror the character.

The small lemon-slice hair clip stays on the same side of her bangs as in the reference image, do not mirror the character.

The small lemon-slice hair clip stays on the same side of her bangs as in the reference image, do not mirror the character.
